summary: Scully Royalty Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board adopted a Policy on Shareholder Reimbursements and Payments, prohibiting reimbursements to shareholders without 75% shareholder approval, effective immediately. The policy includes anti-circumvention provisions and can only be amended or repealed after 60 days' public disclosure. No financial terms, premiums, or shareholder vote date are provided. The filing also notes the resumption of trading on the NYSE. This corporate governance policy change does not involve a transaction, so it falls outside traditional special situations categories.
